shortBio.en: Sex Pistols bassist 1975–77; early writing credit before Sid Vicious replaces him.
shortBio.zh: Sex Pistols 贝斯 1975–77；Sid Vicious 替换前的早期写作署名。

body.en: Melodic bass and songcraft on early singles. Exit 1977 becomes lore: tabloid prefers Vicious as symbol; musicians often prefer Matlock’s parts on record.
body.zh: 早期单曲上的旋律贝斯与写歌。1977 离开成为传说：小报更爱 Vicious 当符号；乐手常更认唱片上 Matlock 的分声部。
